events.title: Shared agenda
events.subtitle: Meetings, drop-in hours and one-off events, each with the reach you choose: your organisation, the network, or everyone.
events.newSub: What is happening, when, where, and who may read it.
events.stat.upcomingHint: Events that have not finished yet
events.stat.publicHint: Readable by everyone, signed in or not
events.section.whatHint: The title is required in the language you write in.
events.section.translationsHint: Optional. A reader whose language is missing gets the text above instead.
events.section.whenHint: Times are the clock of the city the event happens in.
events.section.whereHint: A recorded place, or a written hint when the address must not be published.
events.section.whoHint: The hosting organisation and how far the event reaches.
events.sourceLanguageHint: The reference language: readers of the others fall back to it when a translation is missing.
events.titleRequired: Required in the language written in
events.titleMissing: Add a title in the language written in to save.
events.descriptionHint: Optional — what someone needs to know before coming.
events.allDayHint: The event takes the whole day or days, with no set hours.
events.endDateHint: Leave empty when the event ends the same day.
events.onlineHint: People join from anywhere: no city, no place, no way in to give. The hours stay on mainland France's clock.
events.onlineUrlHint: Optional — the video call address. Published with the event, like the rest of the record.
events.onlineUrlInvalid: Write the link as a web address, https://…
events.preview.title: Public preview
events.placeHint: Optional — the place's publication precision applies.
events.newPlaceNameHint: What it is called locally — “Salle Gérard Philipe” — so it can be found next time.
events.newPlaceHint: The place is saved with the event, in the city chosen above, and is offered to the next one. How precisely it may be shown is set afterwards under Places.
events.locationLabelHint: What can safely be written without exposing a sensitive address.
events.contactLabelHint: Who to reach — a name or a role.
events.contactHint: A service phone number or email, never a personal one.
events.transitHint: How somebody arrives without a car. Published with the event, in every language.
events.hostHint: You can only create an event for an organisation you belong to.
events.visibility.organization.hint: Only members of the hosting organisation see it.
events.visibility.inter_organization.hin: Every verified organisation on the platform sees it. The public does not.
events.visibility.public.hint: Shown on the public site, including to people without an account.
events.visibility.publicWarning: Published for everyone: no sensitive address, no personal contact details, nothing that could put someone at risk.
events.saveError: Could not save. Check the dates and the title, then try again.
events.archivedBody: It is no longer on the agenda or the public site. You can restore it.
events.cancelHint: The event stays visible with its reason, so nobody travels for nothing.
events.cancelReasonHint: One sentence the people concerned can read.
events.reinstateHint: The event is scheduled again and the cancellation reason is cleared.
events.cancelledSuccess: Event cancelled and the reason is now visible to its audience.
events.archivedSuccess: Event archived and removed from the agenda.
events.actionError: The event could not be changed. Try again.
events.archiveBody: Archiving takes the event off every agenda without erasing its history.
events.restoreBody: Restoring puts the event back on the agenda, with the reach it had.
events.readOnlyBody: You can read this event, but not change it.
events.media.title: Image and flyers
events.media.hint: A poster for the event, and PDF flyers to print or pass on.
events.media.draftHint: A poster for the event, and PDF flyers to print or pass on. The files are attached when the event is saved.
events.media.coverHint: Shown with the event wherever it is visible. Confirm you hold the rights.
events.media.altHint: Describe the image for people who cannot see it.
events.media.rights: I confirm we hold the rights to publish this file.
events.media.uploadError: The file could not be uploaded
events.media.flyersHint: One PDF per language: readers download it, print it and put it up.
events.media.flyerTitleHint: This title appears on the download button.
events.media.removeError: The file could not be removed
events.media.constraints: JPG, PNG, WebP or AVIF up to 1 MB, reduced automatically; PDF up to 25 MB.
events.media.pendingScan: Safety check in progress: the file stays hidden from readers until it passes.
